name: Telink Semiconductor(Shanghai)Co.,Ltd.
summary: Telink Semiconductor(Shanghai)Co.,Ltd. engages in research, development, design, and sales of low-power wireless IoT chips. The company also offers wireless communication chip products, such as low-power Bluetooth, dual-mode Bluetooth, Zigbee, Matter, WiFi, etc. Its products are used in computer peripherals, smart homes, smart hardware, smart industrial systems, smart business systems, and other fields. Telink Semiconductor(Shanghai)Co.,Ltd. was founded in 2010 and is based in Shanghai, China.
